clips.title: The story
paras: At the Lakeshire Inn, Darcy keeps the town's defenders fed and spirits up. She serves drinks and warm meals, with a special care for Guard Parker.

Darcy keeps the Lakeshire Inn's counter working through long days and nights. The town's militia come there for food and drink while gnolls and Blackrock orcs keep Lakeshire under pressure. Darcy also looks out for guards posted around town. She asks travelers to carry hot meals and friendly errands to defenders stationed along the borders.

Darcy pays special attention to Guard Parker, who patrols the roads near Three Corners. She thinks he works too hard on an empty stomach and often sends travelers with lunch for him. Darcy watches Martie Jainrose closely, believing her to be jealous and a rival for Parker's favor. Their feelings mingle with the work of defending Lakeshire.
